prompts.text: I'm buying a smartphone in the US for under $1,000. Which three phone brands should I compare for camera quality, battery life, and long-term software support? Explain the tradeoffs and link to official manufacturer pages.

For travel photography and all-day battery life, which three smartphone brands should a US buyer shortlist? Give one current phone model from each and link to official specifications. Avoid rumors and unreleased products.
For a Samsung Galaxy smartphone sold in the US, where can I verify its software update policy, warranty, and repair options? Explain what to check and cite official Samsung pages.
